content.value: . Make sentence with the following structures using the words given in brackets –
(i) Subj.+ verb + object + adverb. (trouble as verb)
(ii) Subj.,+ appositive, + linking verb + adj. complement. (look as verb)
(jii) That + subj. + verb + adj. complement + verb + object. (is and please as verb)
(iv) Subj. + verb + adjective + that + subj + verb + adv. of manner + adv. of place. (is and attend as verb)
(v) Subj. + verb + adj. complement, so + verb + adverb. (is and succeed as verb)
(vi) Subj. + verb + as + adjective + as + subj. + verb. (is and think as verb)
(vii) Since + subj. + verb + adv. of manner, subj. + verb + adv. of manner. (come and behave as verb)
